# E0208: a major version is backward compatible with its predecessor

A new major version is a breaking change: some instance of the predecessor is
not an instance of it. A schema declared as N.0 that is backward compatible
with its predecessor belongs under the previous major version, as its next
minor version.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
				b?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			a: v0_0.a
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			a: v1_0.a
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0208]: schema 1.0 is backward compatible with 0.0, so it is not a major version
  --> lineage.cue:12:4
   |
12 |             schema: {
   |             ^^^^^^
   |
   = help: declare it as version 0.1, or make a breaking change
```
